onboarding.title: Tell us briefly
onboarding.lead: Four steps, under three minutes. Everything except your name and the two checkboxes is optional and can wait.

sections.channels: How did you hear about ChefTreff?

speaker.title: Speaker portal
speaker.lead: Everything for your appearance at the Future Leader Summit.
speaker.noProfileBody: There is no speaker profile for this edition yet. The speaker team creates it and invites you.
speaker.assistantBanner: You are working on behalf of {name}.
speaker.assistantConsentNote: Only the speaker can give consent or enter bank details.
speaker.allDone: All done — great to have you with us.
speaker.stepProfileBody: Name, job title and a short bio in English — that is what appears in the programme.
speaker.stepPhotoBody: The upload is being built. Until then, send us your photo at the speaker mailbox.
speaker.stepConsentsBody: We need photo/video and the speaker release before you appear in the programme.
speaker.stepSessionBody: Once your session is set, you submit title, description and slides here.
speaker.stepTicketBody: Your speaker ticket and the companion ticket appear here once they are issued.
speaker.supportBody: Write to the speaker team. We answer from a shared mailbox so someone always gets back to you.
speaker.profileLead: This is what appears in the programme and on the stage card.
speaker.fieldPronounsHint: Shown next to your name if you want.
speaker.fieldPhoneHint: For the team only, for the day itself.
speaker.fieldBioShortEnHint: Required. Two or three sentences for the programme.
speaker.consentPhotoVideo: Photo and video recordings during the event
speaker.consentSpeakerRelease: Name, bio and photo may be published in the programme
speaker.consentSlides: My slides may be shared after the summit
speaker.consentHospitality: My data may be used for hotel and shuttle
speaker.consentReadOnly: Only the speaker can decide this.
speaker.assistantLead: Your assistant can maintain profile, content and uploads — not consent or bank details.
speaker.assistantRemoveBody: Access ends immediately. You can invite again at any time.
speaker.assistantOnlySpeaker: Only the speaker can invite an assistant.
speaker.sessionLead: Submit your content and upload the presentation.
speaker.noSessionBody: Your session appears here as soon as the programme team assigns you to one.
speaker.submitDone: Submitted — the programme team will look at it.
speaker.deadlineUnknown: The deadline is set once your time slot is fixed.
speaker.deadlinePassedHint: the deadline has passed, you can still upload
speaker.uploadHint: PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote, up to 100 MB. A new file replaces the previous one, the old one is kept.
speaker.uploadLate: late, the team has been notified
speaker.uploadTooBig: The file is larger than 100 MB.
speaker.uploadWrongType: Please use PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote.
speaker.downloadFailed: The file could not be opened.
speaker.slidesConsentMissing: Slid@Home still needs your consent in the profile.
speaker.stepContentBody: Title, description and topics of your session — the programme team fills the announcement from it.
speaker.stepPresentationBody: PDF, PowerPoint or Keynote. At the latest 48 hours before you go on stage.
speaker.expenseLead: Record your receipts and release the expense invoice.
speaker.expenseNotCovered: Travel expenses are not part of your appearance. If that looks wrong, write to the speaker team.
speaker.expenseNotApproved: Travel expenses are planned but not finally approved yet. The area lead does that — you will hear from us.
speaker.positionsHint: One line per receipt. Every line needs a photo or PDF of the receipt.
speaker.bankHint: The IBAN is stored encrypted and only ever shown shortened in the portal.
speaker.bankNeedsDraft: Save at least one receipt line first.
speaker.bankAssistant: Only the speaker can enter the bank details.
speaker.submitHint: After releasing, the claim goes to the area lead. You cannot change it afterwards.
speaker.submitAssistant: Only the speaker can release the claim.
speaker.submitBodyDialog: The claim goes to the area lead and cannot be changed afterwards.
speaker.amountHigh: Single amounts above €5,000 are not accepted — please split them.
speaker.receiptFailed: The receipt could not be uploaded.
speaker.receiptWrongType: Please use a PDF or an image.
speaker.rejectedHint: The claim came back. Change it and release it again.
speaker.invoiceFooter: Created in the ChefTreff portal. No VAT shown.
speaker.waitingSubmitted: The claim is with the area lead. You will get an email once it is decided.
speaker.waitingDecided: This claim is closed. You can start a new one when you have expenses again.
speaker.travelLead: Book hotel and shuttle once the team has unlocked it for you.
speaker.arrivalBody:
The Congress Center Hamburg sits at Dammtor, right in the city.
By train: long-distance services stop at Hamburg Dammtor, a five-minute walk away.
By car: there is a car park at the CCH, the approach is signposted. Allow extra time at rush hour.
On site: the speaker counter in the foyer is your first stop.
speaker.notEligibleBody: The speaker team unlocks hotel and shuttle once your appearance is settled. Nothing for you to do — we will get in touch.
speaker.noOptions: There are no quotas set up for you right now.
speaker.waitlistHint: This quota is full. Your request goes on the waiting list and moves up if someone cancels.
speaker.waitlistNote: You are on the waiting list. If a place opens up, you move up.
speaker.cancelBody: Your place is freed and goes to the waiting list. You can book again afterwards.
speaker.declinedBody: Hotel and shuttle are not part of your appearance. If that looks wrong, write to the speaker team.
speaker.ticketsLead: Your speaker ticket and one companion ticket.
speaker.ticketAfterConfirmation: Your speaker ticket is issued once the team has confirmed your appearance.
speaker.ticketBeingIssued: The ticket is being issued. The code appears here as soon as it is ready.
speaker.loungeHint: This ticket gets you into the speaker lounge.
speaker.qrHint: Have it scanned at the entrance. The code is yours alone — please do not pass it on.
speaker.companionLead: One free ticket for a companion, same pass type, without lounge.
speaker.companionAfterConfirmation: Once your appearance is confirmed you can request a companion ticket here.
speaker.companionEmailHint: The ticket goes to this address.
speaker.companionApprovedHint: Confirmed. The ticket is being issued and goes to {email}.
speaker.companionIssuedHint: Issued. Your companion has received the ticket by email.
speaker.companionIssuedContact: Issued tickets are changed by the speaker team — just write to us.
speaker.companionWithdrawBody: The request is withdrawn. You can make a new one afterwards.
speaker.companionAssistantNote: The assistant may request; your own ticket belongs to you.
speaker.qrSpeakerOnly: The ticket has been issued. Only the speaker sees the QR code.

leads.title: Speaker pipeline
leads.lead: Your speakers in your own scope
leads.emptyScopeBody: No stage, day or edition is assigned to you yet. The speaker team assigns the scope.
leads.newSpeakerHint: Created as a lead first. The invitation goes out once the status is “Confirmed”.
leads.noSessionHint: Not assigned to a session yet. The programme team does that on the board.
leads.contactHidden: Contact details are not visible outside your scope.
leads.pipelineHint: From “Confirmed” the speaker ticket is created automatically and the invitation becomes possible.
leads.fieldEmailHint: If the address already exists, the person is linked instead of created again.
leads.linkPersonHint: Optional. Search starts at two characters.
leads.internalNotesHint: Visible to the team and leads only.
leads.teamFieldsHint: Pass, lounge, hotel tier and the hotel/shuttle unlock are set by the speaker team.
leads.travelApproveHint: The final approval is given by the area lead; only then can the speaker file a claim.
leads.linkByEmailOnly: If the person already exists, the email address links them automatically — no second record is created.
leads.boardLead: Your stages and days. Others stay visible but read-only.
leads.submissionsLead: Titles and descriptions from the speaker portal
leads.submissionsEmptyBody: As soon as a speaker submits a title and description, it shows up here.

leadSubmissions.willBecome: This is what the session will say
leadSubmissions.willBecomeHint: Prefilled from the submission. Whatever stands here is written — the other language stays as it was.
leadSubmissions.noteHint: Required when sending back; it goes to the speaker.
leadSubmissions.titleRequired: The title in the session's language must not be empty.
leadSubmissions.rejectNeedsNote: Please add a note before sending it back.
leadSubmissions.rejectBody: The speaker gets the note and can submit again.

partner.title: Partner portal
partner.lead: Your booth, your services, your deadlines
partner.noOrgBody: Your access works, but no organisation is attached to it yet. The partner team sets that up.
partner.onboardingOpenBody: Company details, description, logo and invoicing are still missing — everything else follows from them.

partner.statTicketsError: Something is wrong with the codes — the team is on it
partner.productsHint: What you see here drives your menu and your checklist.
partner.supportBody: Write to the partner team — we reply the same working day.
partner.onboardingLead: Fill in once, change whenever you need to
partner.onboardingNoRightsBody: Your role cannot change the company details. Your organisation's main contact can.
partner.stepCompanyHint: Prefilled from HubSpot. Correct anything that is off.
partner.stepDescriptionHint: For the website, the event app and the programme. Two to four sentences are enough.
partner.stepLogoHint: Vector file for website, event app and print.
partner.stepInvoiceHint: This is where the SevDesk invoice goes. It needs no login.

partnerContacts.title: Contacts
partnerContacts.lead: Who on your side has access to what
partnerContacts.ownLoginHint: Every person gets their own login — please do not add shared mailboxes. The invoice address is not a contact; it lives in the company details.

partnerContacts.newHint: The person receives an email invitation and signs in themselves.
partnerContacts.fieldEmailHint: The person's work address, not a shared mailbox.
partnerContacts.primaryBody: The current person keeps their access but loses member management.
partnerContacts.removeBody: Access to your organisation ends immediately. The person's profile stays.

partnerChecklist.title: Checklist
partnerChecklist.lead: What we need from you, and by when
partnerChecklist.emptyBody: Your tasks come from the services you booked. Once those are in, they show up here.
partnerChecklist.noRights: Your role cannot submit anything here.
partnerChecklist.uploadHint: Allowed: {allowed}, at most {max}. The file extension decides.
partnerChecklist.uploadWrongType: Only {allowed} are allowed — this file is {got}.

partnerChecklist.infoHint: For your information — tick it off once you have dealt with it.
partnerChecklist.backdropSizeSoon: The backdrop dimensions are not fixed yet; they come from the team.
partnerChecklist.fulfilledByShop: Taken care of by your order in the trade fair shop.

partnerFiles.emptyBody: As soon as you upload something for a task it shows up here — older versions too.

partnerTickets.lead: Your allocations, codes and the secret shop

partnerApplicants.title: Applicants
partnerApplicants.emptyBody: As soon as a masterclass or company tour is assigned to you, it shows up here.

partnerApplicants.noRightsBody: Your role cannot see applicant data. Your organisation's main contact can change that.

partnerStage.title: Your stage
partnerStage.lead: Your programme on your own stage
partnerStage.emptyBody: Your stage is set up by the production team. Once it exists you can plan here.

partnerShop.lead: Furniture, tech and catering for your booth

volunteers.title: Volunteers

volunteers.tooYoung: You need to be 18 on the first day of the event.

programme.hint: Double-click empty space to create a slot.
programme.confirmMoveBody: This session is already published. The change is immediately public and is recorded in the history.
programme.noEventBody: No event with stages exists for this edition yet. That comes from the migration's seed data.
programme.noDayBody: No days have been set up for this event yet.
programme.confirmHoursHint: Time from release to confirm an offer.
programme.titleRequired: A session cannot be saved without a title (DE).
programme.questionsHint: From the question catalogue. Changes save immediately.

applications.title: Applications
applications.lead: Per session: where the applications stand, decide and release.
applications.emptyBody: A session with access mode “application” appears here as soon as it has applications.
applications.queueEmptyBody: No one has applied for this session so far.
applications.notReleasedHint: Applicants only see their status after the release; the emails go out then as well.
applications.releaseBody: Afterwards every applicant sees their status, accepted ones get a confirmation deadline, and the emails go out. This cannot be undone.
applications.maskedHint: This application was not shared — name, profile and answers stay hidden.
applications.notDecidable: Cannot be changed in this status.

roles.title: Roles
roles.lead: Grant and revoke roles with a scope. Every change is in the audit log.
roles.searchHint: Search starts at two characters. Name, and email for admins.
roles.pickBody: Search for a person to see and change their roles.
roles.noRoles: No role recorded for this person yet.
roles.revokeBody: The role ends immediately. The entry stays as history.
roles.assignHint: The same role in the same scope is extended rather than duplicated.
roles.scopeEmpty: Nothing to choose for this scope.
roles.orgSearchHint: Search starts at two characters — name or slug.

expenses.title: Travel expenses
expenses.lead: Review, approve and pay out claims.
expenses.noAccessBody: Only the area lead or an admin approves travel expenses.
expenses.emptyBody: A claim appears here as soon as a speaker releases one.
expenses.revealHint: Every look at the full IBAN is recorded in the audit log.
expenses.noteHint: Required when sending back; the payment reference when paying out.
expenses.approveBody: The expense invoice is created and filed, then the SevDesk voucher and the email to the Qonto inbox go out.
expenses.rejectBody: The speaker receives the note by email and can revise the claim.
expenses.rejectNeedsNote: Please add a note before sending back.

persons.title: People
persons.emptyBody: Records appear here as soon as someone signs in or legacy data is imported.

vocab.title: Vocabulary
vocab.lead: “active” controls whether a value is offered in the forms.

duplicates.title: Duplicate queue
duplicates.lead: Filled by the migration and the matching job.
duplicates.emptyBody: The queue fills up once legacy data is imported or people are merged.

mail.title: Mail delivery
mail.lead: Send a test email and check the most recent deliveries.
mail.resultSuppressed: Address is on the suppression list — not sent.
mail.dryRunHint: No RESEND_API_KEY set: the email was only written to the server log.

ui.title: UI kit
ui.lead: Every building block of the portal in one place — reference for reviews and new areas.

speakerTickets.title: Speaker tickets
speakerTickets.noAccessBody: Only the speaker team sees this overview.
speakerTickets.emptyBody: Tickets appear here once speakers are confirmed.

hospitality.title: Hotels and shuttles
hospitality.emptyBody: No hotel and no shuttle is set up for the edition yet.
hospitality.capacityInvalid: Please enter a whole number from 0.

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.lead: Dates per edition, including the reminder lead time.
deadlines.emptyBody: Without an edition there are no deadlines.
deadlines.reminderHint: 0 to 720 hours. 48 means two days before.
deadlines.newHint: If the key already exists for the edition, the deadline is overwritten.

tech.title: Tech check
tech.emptyBody: Files appear here once speakers upload them.
tech.openFailed: The file could not be opened.

errors.forbiddenBody: You don't have a role for this area. If that looks wrong, contact the ChefTreff team.
